FULL TEXT:
RABINDRA BHARATI UNIVERSITY
56A, B.T. Road, Kolkata-700050
No.RBU/REG/219/2026 Date: 23.09.2026
Applications in Prescribed Proforma are invited for engagement of the following
coaches in Sports Department, Rabindra Bharati University on part-time basis.
Complete application should be submitted in the office of Sports Officer, Rabindra
Bharati University, 56A, B.T. Road, Kolkata-700 050, by 05:00 PM on or before
06.10.2026. After due date no application will be entertained in any circumstance.
1. Athletics : (01)
2. Volleyball : (01)
3. Basketball : (01)
4. Kabaddi : (01)
5. Taekwondo : (01)
General Eligibility Criteria:
* Applicant must be a citizen of India.
* Applicant should not have any criminal record
Essential Qualifications:
* Minimum Educational Qualification: Higher Secondary or its equivalent from by
recognized Board/Council.
* Coaching Qualification: One Year Diploma in Coaching in their respective game.
OR
* Participated in any of the following competition:
* Asian Games
* Commonwealth Games
* National Games
* State Games
* Districts Games
Desirable Experience:
* Preferably Two years coaching experience in relevant sports
Terms and Conditions:
* Age Limit: 35 to 55 years
* Nature of Engagement:
* These engagement are purely temporary and part-time basis initially for one year
and may be extended/ renewed from time to time, based on the performance.
* As these engagement are being made purely on part-time basis. It is understood
that the incumbent will have no claim whatsoever for regular after the expiry of
term of and shall be terminable without any notice.
Monthly Remuneration : Rs.8000/-
* Duty hours are adjustable as per the needs of the Sports Department and as
assigned by the Sports Officer from time to time.
* Only shortlisted candidates shall be called for interview.
* A Screening process will be conducted, followed by interviews/interactions with
shortlisted candidates.
* The candidate must be physically fit and medically certified for coaching duties.
* The selected candidate shall submit an undertaking stating that he/she shall not
claim regular appointment in the University on the basis of this part-time
engagement.
* “No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview or any stage of the selection
process.”
Note: It is mandatory for the applicant to provide a valid e-mail ID and mobile
number in the application from. All communications regarding relating to screening
a interview shall be sent through e-mail and/or telephone. The Sports Officer shall
not be responsible for non-receipt of any communication due to incorrect or inactive
contact details furnished by the application.
Registrar (Acting), RBU
